brand.name: TARC Tech
brand.isotipoMeaning: The core node. Represents connectivity, structure, and automation.

usage.#F97316: Logo, primary buttons, active states. Use dark text (#18181B) on top — white text on this orange fails contrast (~2.9:1). If white text is required, use #C2410C as the button fill instead.
usage.#EA580C: Hover / focus states for buttons and links.
usage.#FFEDD5: Soft backgrounds for alerts or badges in light mode.
usage.#C2410C: Shadows in dark mode; text color for prominent links; button fill when white text is required.
usage.#06B6D4: Code variables, charts, secondary technical icons/badges. Never for primary actions.
usage.#10B981: Semantic success only — completed operations, system-online status. Never decorative.

logotype.usage: Used exclusively for the "TARC Tech" wordmark. Confirmed on Google Fonts (designer: Bernd Montag, OFL license) — load via the combined import above.

primary.usage: All UI text, body copy, and H1–H3 headings (bold). On Google Fonts (designer: Carrois Apostrophe / Mozilla).

accent.style: italic or roman — both confirmed for use
accent.usage: Used for pull quotes, callouts, and keyword emphasis. Italic for quotes/taglines; roman (upright) for keyword highlights that shouldn't slant. On Google Fonts, variable (optical size + weight axes).

mono.usage: Code blocks, technical data, terminal-style UI.

isotipo.source: Final, user-provided artwork (isotipo-gradient.svg / isotipo-gradient-reference.png) — not redrawn, used as-is.
